newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung plans convertible issue - paper.
newsitem.headline: Samsung plans convertible issue - paper.

text.p: Samsung Electronics co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's giant Samsung Group, plans to issue $300 million worth of convertible bonds in July, local reports said on Sunday.
This will be the largest convertible issue by a single South Korean firm.
The reports said the proceeds will be used to help finance the company's imports from abroad.
Samsung plans to issue the non-guaranteed convertibles in the European and U.S. markets and list them on the London Stock Exchange.
Conditions and details of the issue will be announced in the future, reports said.
